id: title:Gilbert09:retry delta merge commit conflicts with a refreshed table

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery from transient Delta Lake conflicts
review.reason: Adds a bounded retry mechanism (max 3) for Delta merge operations when a CommitFailedError occurs, including table refresh and re-execution. This could help PostHog's warehouse ingestion pipelines recover from transient conflicts without failing, potentially improving reliability and reducing manual intervention.
